generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: copy from parent table id pool; include NULL with probability 0.1 when nullable; reserve at least one parent id unreferenced and at least one child row NULL per FK column
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: sample from a small pool of realistic values; include near-variants (case changes, truncations, one-char edits) with probability 0.15
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: sample from a pool of realistic names; include near-variants with probability 0.15
generic_sampling_rules.date_text: sample from a pool of realistic date strings in 'Month D, YYYY' format
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: for nullable columns, 10% NULL unless overridden; always at least one NULL and at least one non-NULL per nullable column per instance
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_values: for columns with listed literal targets, include the literal, one step below and one step above (numeric step 1, text near-variants); merge specification pools into the sampler literal pool so listed targets are guaranteed to appear
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_for_distinct: for DISTINCT-target columns, ensure 20-50% duplicate share
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: for GROUP-target columns, ensure groups of size 1, 2, and >=3; plant jointly with aggregate targets so both hold
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary: for HAVING-target columns, ensure counts straddle the listed threshold (e.g., 0,1,2 for >1; 1,2,3 for >2); plant jointly with group targets so both hold
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join_rows: for join columns, reserve at least one parent id not referenced by any child row and ensure at least one child row has NULL foreign key
